title: The M1/M2 Test System for Determining Macrophage Phenotypes.
snippet: Macrophages are highly plastic innate immune cells that integrate diverse microenvironmental cues to adopt pro-inflammatory (M1) or anti-inflammatory (M2) functional states, which critically influence the pathogenesis of infectious, autoimmune, inflammatory, and malignant diseases.
